report.clinical_summary: Patient with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) on Venetoclax 400mg daily (maintenance) and Obinutuzumab (initial cycles completed). Experiences fatigue, recurrent infections (4-5 times/year), swollen lymph nodes, and unintentional weight loss. The illness has significantly impacted work (can barely get through a shift), relationships (partner supportive but can't help with physical aspects; friends have been insensitive), and activities (used to enjoy hiking and gardening, now short walks are exhausting; avoiding crowded places due to fear of infections). Patient feels overwhelmed, uncertain about the long-term future, and worried about long-term side effects and the possibility of needing additional treatments.
